BI tools expertise: Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Qlik, or Tableau — not limited to one specific platform. Candidate open to working on client’s inhouse BI tool. SQL proficiency: Ability to work with and query relational databases. Python knowledge: Basic to intermediate skills in Python for data transformation and automation. Financial + technical blend: Ideal candidates have both financial and technical experience, though a well-balanced team mix can accommodate specialists in either area. Key Responsibilities:
• Product Strategy & AI Integration: Define the roadmap for AI-powered monitoring and observability enhancements.

• Dashboard & UI Innovation: Conceive and design new interactive dashboards, reporting features, and visualization tools for performance monitoring.

• Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of cloud-based monitoring, virtualization, microservices, and IT observability is a must.

• UI & Visualization: Proficiency in interactive dashboards, heatmaps, and visualization frameworks is preferred.
• Customer-Facing Experience: Ability to make compelling presentations to different internal and external stakeholders as required.
• Product Leadership: Experience defining monitoring metrics, methodologies, and dashboard optimizations is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Exposure to AI-powered automation and predictive anomaly detection.
• Experience designing intuitive monitoring dashboards and report structures
summary: Product Manager – Observability & AI with expertise in cloud-based monitoring tools (Dynatrace, DataDog), AI integration, and dashboard design. Skilled in cross-functional collaboration, data-driven insights, and delivering intuitive, analytics-driven observability solutions.

Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Senior Workday Integration Developer/ Consultant with proven expertise in Workday integrations, configuration, and system optimization.

Adaptable to evolving technology and regulatory environments.
summary: Senior Workday Integration Developer with 5+ years’ experience in Workday Studio, EIB, Core/Cloud Connect, API development, and security protocols. Certified expert skilled in designing scalable, compliant integrations and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic technical solutions.
